description: Temporary whitelist used while auditing SpellDraft cards class by class. The current Mage pass has portal/package cards, Ice Armor, Molten Armor, Frostbolt and Fireball approved. Mage Armor is reopened for a stuck visual effect and incorrect 2-1 resistance tooltip; Arcane Intellect remains under review for group propagation, and normalized Conjure Refreshment is under review while its created consumable is adapted for all levels.
